title: SLOProof OTel Spans (advisory)
description: Server-side OpenTelemetry spans from the checkout service. Advisory context only: the deterministic verifier scores client-observed records in sloproof-requests, and its scoped credential is refused on this data with HTTP 403. The two tables are meant to be read together.

data_source.query: FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS spans = COUNT()
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | EVAL ms = duration / 1000000.0 | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(ms, 95)
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE name == "checkout -> quote" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | EVAL ms = duration / 1000000.0 | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(ms, 95)
FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS errors = SUM(CASE(status.code == "Error", 1, 0))

config.title: p95 by span and version — where the latency goes

data_source.query: FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | EVAL ms = duration / 1000000.0 | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(ms, 95) BY span = name, version = resource.attributes.service.version | SORT version, span

config.title: Request p95 over time, by version

data_source.query: FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | EVAL ms = duration / 1000000.0 | STATS p95_ms = PERCENTILE(ms, 95) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), version = resource.attributes.service.version

FROM traces-generic.otel-default | WHERE name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | EVAL ms = duration / 1000000.0 | STATS spans = COUNT(), errors = SUM(CASE(status.code == "Error", 1, 0)), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(ms, 95) BY run_id = attributes.sloproof.run_id, version = resource.attributes.service.version | SORT spans DESC

FROM sloproof-requests | WHERE traffic_class == "ordinary" AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS requests = COUNT(*), successes = SUM(CASE(success, 1, 0)), p95_ms = PERCENTILE(duration_ms, 95) BY run_id, version | SORT requests DESC
